contexts: city public health unit, about 900,000 people
about 110 pulmonary cases and 1,300 contacts a year
three community clinics and a hospital radiology department
reading: Each handoff in the pathway (case nurse, second nurse, clinic, central office, hospital) is a queue where contacts wait and some are lost. The biggest leak elsewhere is between a positive test and the radiograph, and the hardest-to-reach contacts leak most. Moving the blood draw into the first home visit and routing results to the case nurse remove two handoffs. Measurement depends on a system that misses dates unless checked.
